QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] Crush the King Castle Golem
QuestInfo.0: Cecilia has one last request. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Cecilia wants you to get rid of the King Castle Golem, the terror of the Rose Garden. The King Castle Golem will appear when you hunt a certain number of monsters.
QuestInfo.2: The King Castle Golem is no more. The garden is peaceful once again.

0.0: I have just one more request for you. After this, I can rest in peace. Promise!
0.1: Have you seen the giant monster in the Rose Garden? That's the King Castle Golem. Not only is it huge, it's super strong. It's the reason the garden is in such a sorry state.
0.2: King Castle Golems don't just pop up randomly.  You have to hunt a certain number of monsters to draw them out.
0.3: King Castle Golems can appear anywhere in the Rose Garden, but they usually show up at the Castle Wall's Edges. I bet this will be a lot easier with some friends, too. Can you do it?

yes.0: Okay. Trust me, this will be worth it.\r\n#b(Eliminate King Castle Golem.)#k

no.0: But this is my last request. The last one ever! Are you really giving up?

1.0: It's done, isn't it? I could feel the ground move, and the incredible silence that followed. I feel...so good right now. Thank you. Here, I have something for you.\r\n#r#e- You can choose one of these rewards.#k#n

yes.0: You've done me a great service. Now I can enjoy the garden in peace once more.

mob.0: Okay. Trust me, this will be worth it.\r\n#b(Eliminate King Castle Golem.)#k
